networks.searchPartnersDecision: IMPLEMENTATION DECISION (not specified by the report): OFF at launch so the $100/day budget and the first weeks of search-term and conversion data come from Google Search only. Revisit after the search-terms audit has enough volume.

budget.explanation: Average daily budget, not a hard cap: Google can spend up to 2x ($200) on a single day, and charges at most 30.4x the daily budget ($3,040) in a month when the budget is unchanged all month.

locations.excludedLocationsRule: All active countries in Google's geotarget list except the United States (218). Texas (21176) and the United States (2840) are parents of the target and are never excluded; no US state or county is excluded. Review the file before upload.
